semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: The term '3d geometry processing' often overlaps with '3d shape analysis' as both involve the understanding and manipulation of 3D shapes. They share common techniques and aims, making them semantically equivalent.

'3d processing' is a broad term that encompasses any sort of processing related to 3D data, including geometry processing. They fall under the same overarching category in many contexts, reflecting semantic equivalence.

parent_domains.justification: '3d processing' is a broader term that includes any type of processing related to 3D data, including geometry processing. It serves as a parent domain to various specialized subfields.

'3d data processing' is an overarching category that involves processing any type of 3D data, which includes geometry processing among other tasks. It encompasses a wide range of techniques and applications.
'3d modeling' can be considered a parent as it generally involves various forms of processing, including geometry processing, during the modeling of 3D objects.

closest_parent_domain.justification: Among the parent domains, '3d processing' is the closest to '3d geometry processing' because the latter is inherently a specific type of 3D processing, involving geometric computations and transformations.

child_domains.justification: '3d mesh processing' is a specialized subset of '3d geometry processing', focusing specifically on the processing of mesh data structures in 3D geometry.
'3d shape modeling' can be considered a child domain as it often involves geometry processing to achieve accurate and efficient 3D shapes.

closest_child_domain.justification: '3d mesh processing' is most closely related to '3d geometry processing' as it focuses directly on the geometric representation and manipulation of mesh data, which is a common task in geometry processing.

sibling_domains.justification: '3d vision' relates to interpreting 3D data similar to how '3d geometry processing' might involve interpreting and processing 3D geometric data. Both are under the umbrella of 3D data interpretation.
While a parent domain, '3d modeling' can also be seen as a sibling in the context of being a parallel domain, employing geometry processing as part of a broader scope.
'3d shape generation' is a parallel task to '3d geometry processing', as both involve the creation and manipulation of 3D data but with different focuses.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: '3d vision' is the closest sibling to '3d geometry processing' as they both involve an element of understanding and interpreting 3D data, often utilizing similar base techniques.

unrelated_domains.justification: '3d animation' involves creating moving models and sequences rather than focusing on the technical processing of 3D geometric data, which makes it unrelated to geometry processing.
'3d scene understanding' focuses more on context and semantics of 3D scenes, which diverges from the geometrical computations and transformations concerned in geometry processing.
While deformation is a subset task in modeling, the specific goals of deformation (altering shapes) don't align directly with broader geometry processing tasks focused purely on data processing.
